verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago is a payments platform, not an AI agent or host application, so consuming third-party MCP servers as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence documents only an official Mercado Pago MCP server (the server role) and a Claude Code plugin. Both are server-side or ecosystem offerings and do not make the MCP-client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
